auth.invalidCredentials: That sign-in didn't work. Check your details and try again.
auth.credentialMismatch: This email is already linked to a different sign-in method. Use the option you signed up with.
auth.providerDisabled: This sign-in option isn't available yet. Try another one.
auth.otpInvalid: That code is wrong or expired. Request a new one and try again.
auth.otpRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth.otpPasswordAccount: This address signs in with a password, not an email code.
auth.otpEmailChanged: This email isn't the one on that account anymore. Sign in with the account's current email, or contact support.
auth.otpUnverifiedAccount: This email is waiting to be confirmed on another account. Sign in the way you usually do, or contact support.
auth.otpAccountDeleting: This account is being deleted, so it can't sign in. Contact support if that's a mistake.
auth.otpAccountMerging: We're updating this account. Request a new code in a couple of minutes.
auth.network: Can't reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.userDisabled: This account has been disabled. Contact support.
auth.configError: Sign-in isn't set up correctly. Please contact support.
auth.signOutIncomplete: We couldn't finish signing you out on this device, so you may still be signed in next time you open Houston. Try signing out again, and if it keeps happening, restart your computer.
auth.signInTimeout: Sign-in is taking too long to open your browser. Please try again.
auth.localDataIncomplete: We signed you out, but some data cached on this device couldn't be removed. Nothing private is exposed. Restart Houston if anything looks out of date.
auth.storageUnavailableTitle: Can't reach this device's secure storage
auth.storageUnavailableBody: We couldn't open the secure storage on this device where your sign-in is kept. This usually clears up on its own. Try again, and if it keeps happening, restart your computer.
